reason: Deleting semantic IR contracts 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 (leaving 2.0.0 the only contract) touches every reader of them: schema/, fixtures/, crates/semantic-ir, crates/conformance-adapter, src/compiler, packages/semantic-kernel, and their tests.
